logs: Database connection pool exhausted. Active connections: 100/100. Connection leak suspected in v2.4.1 handler.
root_cause: Connection leak introduced in v2.4.1 database connection pool initialization logic.
resolution: Rolled back deployment to v2.4.0 and restarted affected payment-api instances.
outcome: Resolved in 11 minutes. Service metrics stabilized.

logs: Unable to obtain database connection. Connection pool timeout after 30000ms. Pool size: 80/80.
root_cause: Unreleased database connections in order placement transactional block introduced in v3.1.0.
resolution: Rolled back deployment to v3.0.9 and restarted order-api pods.
outcome: Resolved in 14 minutes. DB connection pool usage normalized.

logs: PostgreSQL connection pool max size reached. Connections not released by inventory locking mechanism.
root_cause: Missing try-finally block in row-level pessimistic locking mechanism causing connection retention.
resolution: Rolled back to v1.9.3 and patched connection cleanup logic.

logs: SignatureVerificationError: Key ID 'rsa-2026-b' not recognized by auth gateway.
root_cause: Signing-key rotation mismatch between auth-service and edge gateway during key propagation.
resolution: Synchronized public signing keys across nodes and re-deployed auth gateway configuration.

logs: RabbitMQ queue length exceeding threshold (45,000 pending messages). Consumer throughput degraded.
root_cause: Consumer worker thread pool bottleneck caused by missing index on user_email table query.
resolution: Scaled worker replicas from 4 to 12 and created B-tree index on user_email column.

logs: P99 latency elevated to 4200ms. CPU usage at 98% on Elasticsearch search cluster nodes.
root_cause: Unoptimized leading wildcard query introduced in v2.1.0 search query builder.
resolution: Rolled back deployment to v2.0.4 and re-indexed search mapping analyzer.

logs: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Max number of clients reached (10000/10000).
root_cause: Redis connection pool leak in user session caching middleware.
resolution: Increased Redis maxclients parameter and deployed hotfix releasing cache connections.

logs: ConnectTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.stripe-gateway.com', port=443): Read timed out after 15000ms.
root_cause: Upstream third-party payment provider latency spike combined with missing circuit breaker fallback.
resolution: Enabled resilience4j circuit breaker with fallback error response and updated HTTP timeout to 5000ms.

logs: ERROR: deadlock detected. Detail: Process 14201 waits for ShareLock on transaction 881245.
root_cause: Inconsistent locking order between order_items table and stock_reservations table across parallel checkout workers.
resolution: Standardized table lock order alphabetically across transaction handlers and applied hotfix patch.

logs: Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process auth-service (PID 142) memory usage: 2048MB/2048MB.
root_cause: Memory leak in in-memory session token revocation cache failing to expire evicted tokens.
resolution: Restarted pods, reduced token cache TTL, and replaced in-memory dict with LRU cache policy.
